summary: Curriculum lesson page is BROKEN — crashes on render with 'ReferenceError: access is not defined'. CurriculumLesson.tsx imports useCurriculumAccess but never calls it, yet references `access.canRead.deep`, `access.canRead.flash`, `access.canRead.citations`, `access.isAuthenticated` throughout the JSX. All tier gating tests (Free/Cellar Hand/Press/Vigneron) cannot be executed because the page never mounts. Index (/curriculum) and about (/curriculum/about) pages render correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: access is not defined at CurriculumLesson.tsx:126:201 — page shows ErrorBoundary fallback 'An unexpected error occurred'. Root cause: `useCurriculumAccess` is imported (line 16) but never invoked in the component body; `access` variable is referenced in ~7 places (lines 94, 95, 160, 162, 166, 175, 180, 186, 190).

Initial reading mode hardcoded to 'deep' (line 52: useState<Mode>('deep')). Per spec, Free Run tier default should be 'skim'. Once the ReferenceError is fixed, this must also be updated — e.g. useState<Mode>(access.canRead.deep ? 'deep' : 'skim') computed after the hook call.
Dead code: obsolete PaywallBoundary component (lines 532-571) still present with old data-testid='paywall-boundary'. Old testid should be removed per handoff note.

onClick for mode-deep is `() => access.canRead.deep ? setMode('deep') : setMode('deep')` — both branches identical. When locked, clicking still sets mode to 'deep' which will render UpsellBoundary (that part works), but the ternary is nonsensical and misleading.

action_items: Add `const access = useCurriculumAccess();` near the top of CurriculumLesson component (after useRoute/useState hooks, before the useMemo). This unblocks all tier-gating tests.
Change initial mode useState from 'deep' to computed default based on access.canRead.deep (Free Run should default to Skim per spec).
Remove dead PaywallBoundary component and its paywall-boundary testid (replaced by UpsellBoundary).
Simplify the mode-deep onClick ternary — both branches are identical.
After fix: rebuild (vite build) and re-test with ?preview=free|cellar_hand|press|vigneron.
critical_code_review_comments: Missing hook invocation caused a full component crash — an eslint rule (no-undef) or TypeScript strict mode should have caught this. Recommend running `tsc --noEmit` in CI.
Rules of Hooks fine (all hooks at top), but the missing call means the gating logic is entirely non-functional in code review, not just at runtime.
Leftover PaywallBoundary is dead code — should have been deleted when replaced by UpsellBoundary.

success_rate.frontend: 20% (index + about pages OK; all lesson pages crash)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Once main agent adds `const access = useCurriculumAccess();` and fixes default mode, re-run the 4 tier scenarios via ?preview=<tier> on /curriculum/fermentation-management and verify: (a) Free = skim-mode visible, mode-deep locked, click shows upsell-boundary + upsell-cta-pricing; (b) cellar_hand+ = deep mode default with worked-example/decision-tree/mcqs, flash mode works, NO upsell-boundary.
rca of the issue: REPRO: GET https://private-tutor-2.preview.emergentagent.com/curriculum/fermentation-management. Console shows `ReferenceError: access is not defined at CurriculumLesson`.
